digest.component_or_area: tickets-store git maintenance and history reclaim
propositions: Tickets branch filtered pack size has grown to 131431 KiB, exceeding the 131072 KiB CI verification gate limit and blocking stale-base changes from merging
History rewriting via git fast-export/filter/fast-import must reclaim spent ~1 GiB from scattered .bridge_state versions that are unreachable after filter-based history strip
git repack and gc operations are required after history rewrite to release disk bytes from now-unreachable historical objects; repack alone cannot reclaim this delta without the filter step

All writer activity (GitHub workflows, rebar-mcp servers, AWS timer, LaunchAgents) must be paused and operator-confirmed zero-active before tracker convergence, backup creation, or any history mutation

Identity verification must be identical pre/post-rewrite when comparing (event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered) multisets while ignoring rewritten commit SHAs, with tree, commit count, and merge count all preserved

Publication via force-with-lease must succeed with exact old/new tip, old tip must be absent from published clone, identity summary must match, and incremental post-rewrite growth must stay below 1 MiB threshold
